_meanings:
<ab>N.</ab> of a demon and brother of Upasunda, who were sons of Nikumbha.
 [They got a boon from the Creator that they would not die until they should
 kill themselves. On the strength of this boon, they grew very oppressive
 and Indra had at last to send down a lovely nymph named Tilottamā, and
 while quarrelling for her, they killed each other.]
